requestedText: Add the direct URL parser dependency required by the runtime source safety validator.

evidence: The manifest change adds a compile-time parser dependency only; it does not load runtime references dynamically.
No package consumer contract changes; the existing repository crate owns the direct dependency.
The dependency declaration adds no monitoring, scheduler, or operational integration.
The Contract scopes Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock and requires build, test, and quality verification.
